title: PR review/merge automation - phased cloud_ultra->swarm_local + permission gate
objective: ADR-0001 §5: reviewer is always a separate role, filled by merge.reviewer. Phase 1 cloud_ultra: `hf review request <pr#>` runs /code-review ultra on the PR, records approve/deny via weave review (WL-020) + permission ask (WL-021). Phase 2 swarm_local: replace with ruvector/ruflo agent-swarm reviewer. `hf merge <pr#>` merges only on approved+permission-granted (gh pr merge --squash), ff develop; deny re-opens task; pending waits (retryable). permission_gate is transitional (lift once swarm trusted). Target current-weave queues only.
acceptance_criteria: PR review/merge automation - phased cloud_ultra->swarm_local + permission gate: implemented + cargo test green + checkpointed
